title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados | Rio de Janeiro
description: Nesta oportunidade de Engenheiro(a) de Dados, você será responsável por construir e otimizar nossa infraestrutura de dados, também atuará como uma referência técnica e mentor(a), capacitando nossas equipes de Analistas, Especialistas e Cientistas de Dados a extraindo o máximo valor dos nossos ativos de dados, assumindo a propriedade de domínios de dados e garantindo que nossas soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e governadas. Aqui na Pulse temos compromissos com a equidade de oportunidades para todas as pessoas. Valorizamos as diferenças e temos um ambiente onde todos e todas são mais que bem-vindos, por isso buscamos diversidade em identidade de gênero, idade, cor e etnia, orientação afetivo-sexual, origem, pessoas com deficiência e entre outras diversidades, pois entendemos que todas as pessoas devem sonhar, crescer e realizar. Para te ajudar a entender este desafio, aqui estão algumas responsabilidades: Construção de Pipelines de Dados: Desenvolver, otimizar e manter pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) robustos, eficientes e escaláveis, utilizando o ecossistema Azure Databricks, incluindo Databricks Jobs e Delta Live Tables (Pipelines); Otimização e Performance: Otimizar a performance de queries complexas e processos de ingestão e transformação, garantindo o processamento eficiente de grandes volumes de dados; Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para o time de dados, promovendo as melhores práticas de engenharia, governança e qualidade de dados, mentorando o time de Dados; Monitoramento e Qualidade: Implementar e manter rotinas de monitoramento que garantam a saúde, a consistência e a qualidade dos nossos pipelines e bases de dados; Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento em Data Mesh: Liderar a concepção e ser o guardião técnico de domínios de dados específicos, garantindo a qualidade, disponibilidade, segurança e documentação dos "produtos de dados"; Governança de Dados: Implementar e disseminar estratégias de governança de dados dentro do time, incluindo conhecimento de todos os domínios de dados, garantindo a conformidade e a segurança das informações acessadas; Suporte Estratégico: Colaborar ativamente com stakeholders, Analistas e Cientistas de Dados para entender os requisitos de negócio e traduzi-los em soluções de dados eficazes e estratégicas, disponibilizando datasets prontos para consumo; Disseminação da Cultura Data-Driven: Agir como um evangelista de dados, auxiliando as áreas de negócio a compreender e utilizar os dados disponíveis para tomar decisões mais inteligentes. Para esta oportunidade, é necessário que você: Superior Completo em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência sólida e comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados, atuando em ambientes de Big Data; Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com a plataforma Databricks no ambiente Azure (ADB), dominando seu principais componentes como Databricks JOBs, Delta Live Tables, e integração com Azure Data Lake Stirage (ADLS); Domínio avançado de Python e SQL para manipulação e processamento de dados em larga escala; Experiência avançada com Apache Spark / PySpark, incluindo otimização de jobs e performance; Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados (Dimensional, Data Vault) e arquitetura de dados; Compreensão profunda e vivência prática com os conceitos e a implementação de arquiteturas Data Mesh; Experiência com práticas e ferramentas de governança de dados (Data Governance), qualidade de dados (Data Quality) e segurança; Conhecimento em ferramentas de versionamento de código, como Git; Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e mentoria. É um diferencial se você possuir: Conhecimento em bancos de dados NoSQL, especialmente MongoDB; Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Executivo(a) de Contas L'Oréal Grande Público - Rio de Janeiro (RJ)
description: L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a "Criar a beleza que move o mundo"; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo. Na Divisão de Grande Público, nossa missão é democratizar o melhor da beleza, que significa levar a beleza para todos. E para nós, a beleza deve ser sustentável. A DPGP é a maior divisão do grupo L'Oréal, com mais de 30 mil colaboradores ao redor do mundo. A nossa equipe é composta por profissionais estratégicos, criativos e orientados para resultados, que trabalham em parceria com nossos clientes e as áreas do business para impulsionar o crescimento do nosso negócio. title: Recepcionista (Auditor Noturno)
description: No Hilton , acreditamos que cada chegada deve ser uma experiência calorosa e cada saída, uma vontade de voltar. Nossa equipe de Recepção é o primeiro sorriso do hotel — aquele que dá o tom da hospitalidade Hilton, reconhecida mundialmente por excelência, cuidado e autenticidade. Se você gosta de acolher pessoas, criar experiências memoráveis e deseja trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, elegante e com forte cultura de serviço, esta oportunidade é para você. Como Recepcionista , você será parte essencial da jornada do hóspede, garantindo atendimento impecável, personalizado e alinhado aos padrões internacionais da marca Hilton. Descrição da posição Responsável direto pelo atendimento a hóspedes e clientes com o objetivo de contribuir para uma experiência excepcional desde o momento do check-in ao check-out, conforme padrões estabelecidos pela empresa, bem como a resolução de eventuais desafios que possam surgir. Responsável pela primeira impressão dos hóspedes e clientes do hotel. Promover os serviços dos pontos de venda do hotel. Administrar o fundo fixo de caixa de forma adequada, respeitando os padrões e procedimentos estabelecidos pela empresa. Fechamento de caixa, verificando todos os lançamentos para que estes estejam condizentes com as comandas preenchidas e assinadas; conferir o fundo de caixa diariamente, sendo que este deve ser com o valor estabelecido pelo departamento financeiro para o membro de equipe. Prestar informações a hóspedes, clientes e a equipe sempre que solicitado, atendendo a possíveis necessidades e garantindo satisfação a todos. Completar o processo de registro dos hóspedes (check-in) seguindo os padrões de qualidade da Marca Canopy, utilizando o sistema eletrônico adotado pela empresa, selecionando apartamento através das preferências dos hóspedes, previamente associadas à reserva, ou solicitadas in loco. Work primarily on funds focused on Latin America and the Caribbean, supporting Finance in Motion’s investment teams to execute the company’s approach to E&S risk management through the investment cycle. Most investments target financial intermediaries such as banks, microfinance institutions and leasing companies, while a growing share target businesses, corporates and renewable energy projects. E&S screening of prospective investments against the funds’ eligibility criteria. Plan and conduct in‑depth E&S due diligence, focusing on investee management policies, practices and capacities. Negotiate value‑adding E&S action plans with investees. Write E&S memoranda to support investment proposals and advise decision makers. Monitor and report on the ongoing E&S performance of individual investees and overall fund portfolios. Support the development of methodologies and tools for E&S management and related fields. Build and implement E&S frameworks for new fund mandates and provide E&S training to internal and external stakeholders. Contribute to technical and policy‑level discussions on impact, sustainability issues and fund results with internal and external stakeholders. Qualifications University degree in environmental engineering, forest engineering, forest resources management, environmental science, economics, development finance, sustainability management, social science or a related field. Relevant internships and/or professional experience in E&S risk management or similar work in environmental consultancies or development finance sectors. Knowledge of international E&S standards (especially IFC Performance Standards) and/or specialist expertise in areas such as sustainable forestry and agriculture, supply chains, environmental and social impact assessments, responsible finance and consumer protection, pollution prevention and control, sustainable finance regulation and climate risk. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, service orientation and the ability to draw actionable conclusions and pragmatic recommendations for decision makers. Organizational skills and self‑drive. Open, engaging and persuasive communication style, strong writing and presentation skills. Excellent English, Spanish and/or Portuguese language skills; knowledge of other languages of Finance in Motion’s countries of operation is considered a plus. Benefits An agile, diverse international working environment of over 60 nationalities, shared collaborative, can‑do spirit. A job that allows you to fully utilize and expand your skills within an innovative, hands‑on company culture. A purpose‑driven, performance‑oriented company that rewards above‑average results. An organization dedicated to providing effective training and up‑skilling to its employees. A flexible and amicable work environment that values work‑life balance. About the Team We, a team of over 300 dedicated professionals across 16 regional offices worldwide, are committed to advancing sustainable development through pioneering finance solutions. If you relish tackling complex challenges hands‑on and crave an adaptable and motivating work environment, we’re eager to connect with you. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MÉDICO ESF - AP 3.3 (Zona Norte)
description: Estratégia Saúde da Família A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade. As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS). Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião‑dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal. Responsabilidades Realizar atendimento na Estratégia Saúde da Família, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde e protocolos existentes. Realizar assistência à população sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual, coletiva e incluindo ações no domicilio. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde. Qualificações Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina; Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe; Desejável experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Médico. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Legacy Manager
description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. Department Strategy & Planning Location Brazil The Position Reporting to the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA. Key Responsibilities Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long‑lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event. Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars: Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGOs and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender‑based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027. Prepare and finalise a report to be released post‑tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact. Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required. Your Profile Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events. Proven track record of working in women’s football in Brazil (and the wider Region) with clear links and networks to key women’s football stakeholders. Legacy Development Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies. Experience in Project Management including planning, organising, and delivering complex projects and campaigns. Experience in delivering post‑event reporting. Communication & Stakeholder Relations Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high‑level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary). Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials. Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries. Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian). Right to work in Brazil and ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Apoiar iniciativas de comunicação e aculturamento do Programa de Compliance. Formação acadêmica Graduação em Direito, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Certificações Cursos ou certificações em Compliance, Governança ou Gestão de Riscos (diferencial). Conhecimentos específicos Conhecimento em Compliance, incluindo noções da Lei nº 12.846/2013 e do Decreto nº 11.129/2022, bem como familiaridade com legislações e referências internacionais anticorrupção e antissuborno, como FCPA (EUA) e UK Bribery Act (Reino Unido), regimes de sanções internacionais (ex.: OFAC e União Europeia) e diretrizes nacionais e internacionais aplicáveis, como o Programa de Integridade da CGU e as diretrizes da OCDE. Hiring: Two Faculty Positions (open rank) for Fall 2026 Position Title: Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor of Social Work Appointment Type: Full-Time, Tenure-Track Department: Social Work Reports To: Dean, School of Social Work The Howard University School of Social Work (HUSSW) invites applications for two open-rank faculty positions: Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor. Founded in 1867, and located in Washington, DC, in our nation’s capital, Howard University is a historically Black College/University and Research 1 (R1) institution with a distinguished legacy of advancing knowledge, leadership, and service in pursuit of social justice and equity. Serving 400 students, the Howard University School of Social Work offers two MSW concentrations: Direct Practice and Community, Administration, and Policy Practice. These concentrations are delivered through two program platforms, on-campus (Flagship) and online (Starship). The School offers specializations in criminal justice, health, mental health, family and child welfare, displaced populations, and social gerontology. We also offer three dual degree programs: MSW/MPH, MSW/MDiv, and MSW/MBA. Additionally, the School offers a Ph.D. in Social Work with specialized areas of scholarly inquiry. Grounded in the University’s enduring motto, Truth and Service, the HUSSW prepares scholars and practitioners committed to improving human well-being and addressing the structural conditions that affect marginalized communities. The School’s guiding philosophy, Black Perspective, further shapes its intellectual and practice framework through our curriculum and faculty scholarship that examine social and economic injustice, social determinants of health, behavioral health, poverty, and disparities effecting quality of life, particularly for African Americans and other historically oppressed populations. Our School has been continuously accredited during its 90-year history. We are a highly ranked graduate/professional program at the university having been ranked by the U.S. News and World Report among the country’s top-20 MSW programs. Position Summary The School of Social Work seeks candidates for two open-rank faculty positions (Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor), with rank determined based on qualifications and experience. Successful candidates will be responsible for teaching, research and scholarship, and service consistent with the mission of the institution and the accreditation standards of the Council on Social Work Education. The position emphasizes high-quality teaching, the development and/or maintenance of a sustainable research agenda, and meaningful contributions to service within the school, university, profession, and community. With an abiding interest in both domestic and international affairs, the University is committed to continuing to produce leaders for America and the global community. To Apply For consideration, submit a letter of interest outlining research, teaching, service, and practice experiences along with a curriculum vitae and two samples of scholarly work. title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more. Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials. Come take off with us! Compensation Range: $150K - $450K #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing. We are looking for a Pricing & Payments Manager to lead the Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of partner pricing models, incentive programs, payment accuracy, and dispute resolution across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large). As a People Manager, you will lead and develop a team of specialists, set the strategic direction for pricing and payment mechanisms, build scalable processes, and drive cross‑functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable. This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel. If you are passionate about partner economics, operational excellence, and building high‑performing teams, you should join our team. Your focus centers on strategic decisions that shape partner economics across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL. You lead cross‑functional negotiations with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to align pricing models with business objectives. You assess incentive program ROI, recommending adjustments to optimize cost efficiency and partner performance. You review payment accuracy dashboards, identifying systemic gaps and designing scalable mechanisms to address them. Between meetings, you coach your team on stakeholder influence and data‑driven storytelling. Every day balances strategic thinking, cross‑functional alignment, and talent development to drive sustainable partner economics at scale. About the team The Pricing & Payments team is part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP, AMXL, and AMPL programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive, transparent, and accurate pricing and payment frameworks, while driving performance through well‑designed incentive programs and efficient dispute resolution. We build scalable pricing models, payment governance mechanisms, and incentive strategies that balance cost efficiency with partner sustainability. The team sits within a broader strategic structure that also covers Compliance & Communications, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross‑functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil. title: Communications Technician
description: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the‑art Satellite fleet consists of 14 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat‑1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit Reporting to the Manager, Satellite Operations, the Communications Technician performs real time Telemetry, Track and Control (TTC) of all satellites operated by Telesat Brazil and monitors ground systems according to established procedures and policies; is responsible for all aspects of successful in‑orbit mission operations; serves as an interface to internal and external customers, as it relates to the daily transponder accesses; and is responsible for the overall ground station or facilities operations. Responsibilities Satellite In-Orbit Operations Monitor all in-orbit satellite performance. Provide routine operations to maintain the satellite orbit and subsystems health. Provide emergency system operations in accordance with contingency plans; Respond immediately to all anomalous events and/or alarms; Prepare anomaly reports to engineers for further investigation; Operate, configure and monitor satellite subsystems, including: Power, Thermal, Reaction Control, Attitude, TT&C, and Communications; Perform station keeping maneuvers, battery reconditioning, eclipse operations, and other routine operations; Maintain and operate ground station TT&C equipment: Antenna Control Units, Command, Ranging and Telemetry racks, and Command Encryption modules; Maintain and operate front-end processors and associated computers; Conduct special satellite testing as directed by satellite engineering/management. Customer Service Operations Answer incoming calls from Uplinkers, Customers, and persons requesting information. Perform Uplinker performance checks and transponder-access tests, including Transponder frequency, Polarization, Deviation, and Power. Correlate power/polarization level adjustments with field technicians. Monitor consoles, maintain event logs, and enter information into databases. Perform troubleshooting of reported video and audio troubles using appropriate test equipment. Identify and elevate service outages and abnormal conditions. Assist other technicians during busy times and provide relief during breaks and lunch periods. Respond to all customer trouble calls and inquiries - initiate, review, update, and clear trouble tickets. Coordinate customer booking problems and transponder service extensions with Telesat Engineering. Perform satellite and transponder restorations as directed by the restoration plans. Assist Engineering and customer Field Engineers as requested. Perform in-service 'Console Transponder Calibration' tests using supplied hardware/software. Setup consoles and monitor audio teleconferencing bridges for satellite news feeds. Perform calibration tests on spectrum analyzers and other equipment used in the Service Assurance Center (SAC). Coordinate customer additions and disconnects as directed by scheduled Service Orders. Coordinate satellite transponder change requests as directed by Engineering. Isolate and resolve satellite transponder interferences. Perform certification tests for all new digital uplinkers. Ground Station/Facilities Operations Operate, configure and monitor ground station subsystems, including: Electric, Air Conditioning, Communications, IT; Maintain and operate ground station equipment: Antennas, RF, IF, Communications, test equipment; Record all significant customer activities or internal events in the station log; Maintain and update facility site documentation; Perform preventive and corrective maintenance; Prepare Performance Analysis reports, as requested by engineering/management; Develop, maintain and distribute daily reports, operational shift logs and trouble ticket database to appropriate individuals on a needed basis; Prepare and distribute (E-mail) daily reports; File completed logs; Perform shipping, ordering, handling, inventory, and testing of on‑line and spare parts; Monitor building, fire, and security systems. Handle on-call, special and In-Charge assignments Education and Experience required Technical specialization (Certified Technician) on Telecommunications or Electronics. Ability to write, read and speak on both English and Portuguese languages. Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals; Ability to write routine reports and correspondence; Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization. Decision making and Supervision: Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action; Receives instructions on new assignments or projects; Actively seeks information and guidance to improve own performance. title: Especialista em Arquitetura Soluções | Infra e Telecom - Arquitetura de Tecnologia
description: Descrição da vaga Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços. Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay. Desafios estratégicos: O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps. Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário. Atuação de Arquitetura: A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução. A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa. Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia. O que a área te oferece de oportunidade: Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa Diversidade: Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (RJ ou SP) Responsabilidades e atribuições Como será seu dia a dia: Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de Infraestrutura e Telecom, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia tecnológica e de negócio da companhia; Construir e manter modelos arquiteturais, mapas de capacidades, princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos para orientar decisões executivas e estruturantes de I&T; Produzir desenhos arquiteturais de alto nível conectando domínios, plataformas e capacidades tecnológicas; Atuar de forma crítica e consultiva junto às áreas técnicas, questionando soluções, identificando lacunas e propondo direcionamentos estruturantes; Avaliar impactos arquiteturais de novas iniciativas, tecnologias e decisões estratégicas; Incorporar o conceito de AI-First Architecture nas decisões e modelos arquiteturais, promovendo automação, inteligência operacional e uso estratégico de dados; Comunicar e apresentar conceitos arquiteturais para públicos técnicos e executivos. Ponto de atenção: Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo. Requisitos e qualificações Do que você precisa: Formação superior em carreiras de tecnologia, como engenharias, ciência da computação, etc; Pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura, Tecnologia, Telecom, Cloud ou áreas afins. Inglês Avançado/Nativo para leitura, escrita e comunicação; Experiência como arquiteto corporativo, arquiteto de domínio ou arquiteto de soluções; Experiência em ambientes tecnológicos complexos, distribuídos, híbridos ou multicloud; Vivência em Infraestrutura, Telecomunicações ou ambos, com capacidade de sustentar decisões arquiteturais nesses domínios; Experiência na definição de arquiteturas e direcionamentos técnicos em contextos de transformação tecnológica ou organizacional; Experiência em modelagem de capacidades (Capability Mapping) e construção de modelos arquiteturais; Capacidade de definir princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos; Domínio em infraestrutura on-premises, cloud ou ambientes híbridos; Entendimento de resiliência, disponibilidade, escalabilidade, automação e observabilidade em plataformas tecnológicas; Expertise em arquitetura de redes, conectividade e serviços de telecom; Entendimento conceitual de IA e suas relações com infraestrutura e telecom. Conhecimentos que te destacam: Experiência em ambientes multicloud ou arquiteturas híbridas complexas; Experiência com infraestrutura como código e automação de plataformas; Vivência em telecom definidos por software (SDN / NFV); Experiência em integração entre ambientes on-premises e cloud; Conhecimento em uso de IA em operações de tecnologia (AIOps ou Enterprise AI Solutions Architecture); Experiência anterior em arquitetura de soluções, engenharia ou operações, combinada com visão sistêmica; Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Turismo, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Comunicação: Clareza na comunicação, escuta ativa e habilidade para conduzir conversas comerciais do zero. Perfil de Owner: Proatividade, iniciativa e capacidade de fechar ciclos de trabalho sem necessidade de instruções constantes. Ferramentas: Experiência com CRM (Hubspot), Google Workspace e ferramentas de análise de dados. Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes na região do RJ e Costa Verde. É importante que tenha CNH ativa Idiomas: Português nativo; inglês intermediário; espanhol é um diferencial. Paixão por Travel: Interesse genuíno pelo setor de hospitalidade online e turismo. title: Especialista de Arquitetura de Dados e IA - Arquitetura de Tecnologia
description: Descrição da vaga Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços. Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay. Desafios estratégicos O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps. Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário. Atuação de Arquitetura A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução. A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa. Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia. O que a área te oferece de oportunidade Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa Posição de Arquitetura de Dados & IA Esta posição irá ajudar a evoluir a arquitetura fundacional de dados & IA da Globo, que habilita os workloads de analytics, machine learning, generative AI e agentic AI. Diversidade Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. Modelo de trabalho Híbrido (RJ ou SP) Responsabilidades e atribuições Como será seu dia a dia Projetar a evolução da arquitetura da plataforma de dados e analytics; Projetar a evolução da arquitetura da plataforma de IA (ML, GenAI, Agentic AI); Projetar a evolução da arquitetura de governança de dados & AI; Mapear e continuamente avaliar o landscape de vendors de tecnologia; Rastrear tendências de dados & IA e transformar em oportunidades para evolução da arquitetura; Conduzir assessments e benchmarks de tecnologia; Construir e evoluir frameworks de capabilities e arquiteturas de referência. Ponto de atenção Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo. Requisitos e qualificações Do que você precisa Vivência com arquitetura fundacional de dados & IA , que habilita os workloads de analytics, machine learning, generative AI e agentic AI para diferentes necessidades de negócio; Inglês avançado/nativo; Formação superior; Especializações na área Dados & AI. Conhecimentos que te destacam Atuação prévia em arquitetura de soluções ou arquitetura corporativa; Conhecimento do stack de dados & IA do Google; Capacidade de entender e comunicar desafios complexos com clareza, estruturando mensagens de forma objetiva e adaptada a diferentes públicos. Informações adicionais Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link: Ao prosseguir você está ciente e de acordo para realização de sua candidatura nestes termos. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: External Relations Officer
description: The External Relations Department drives DNDi’s visibility, influence, and financial sustainability. DNDi established its Latin American office in Rio de Janeiro in 2004. Since then, DNDi Latin America has made extensive contributions to advancing R&D and access partnerships across the region’s diverse health ecosystems. Its work spanning neglected diseases such as Chagas disease, leishmaniasis, hepatitis C, and dengue plays a central role in delivering DNDi’s global strategy. The office also leads advocacy efforts and drives capacity‑building initiatives through multi‑country clinical research and drug discovery platforms. The External Relations Officer supports DNDi’s fundraising efforts by carrying out prospect research, developing grant proposals, managing donor reporting, and supporting day‑to‑day grant management, including institutional, public and private funding. Working closely with the External Relations Manager (ERM) and the global External Relations team, the Officer plays an active role in helping secure and steward resources essential to DNDi’s mission. Approximately 60% of the role is dedicated to Latin America , supporting institutional, public, and private sector fundraising activities in the region, and 40% to global priorities , including prospect research, donor engagement, acknowledgements, and cross‑team efficiency initiatives. This position is suited for a professional with strong writing and analytical skills , a clear interest in fundraising and development cooperation , and a commitment to working in the non‑profit and public health sector . General Responsibilities (for both LATAM and Global) Support grant writing and proposal development, including drafting narrative sections, compiling supporting documentation, and coordinating internal inputs. Contribute to donor reporting, ensuring clarity, consistency, and compliance with donor requirements. Conduct prospect research and analysis of calls for proposals from institutional, public, and private donors. Support grant and donor activities, including record‑keeping, tracking deadlines, and updating Salesforce and internal systems. Provide administrative and coordination support to fundraising activities, including organizing meetings, preparing briefs and documentation, and following up on action points. Latin America‑Specific Responsibilities (Minimum 60%) Monitor, map, and analyze existing and emerging donor opportunities relevant to DNDi’s work in Latin America. Support the preparation of regional funding proposals and concept notes. Assist in the coordination and management of local fundraising consultants, as required. Global‑Specific Responsibilities (up to 40%) Ad hoc support to global fundraising initiatives. Additional /Project‑Specific Responsibilities Participate in internal and external regional and global meetings related to fundraising, partnerships, and external relations. Liaise with internal departments (R&D, Communications, Regional Offices) to support fundraising‑related inputs and coordination. External Relations Officer reports to External Relations Manager. Contributing manager - Associate Director. Works closely with DNDi staff across the Latin America Regional Office and with global External Relations, Communications, R&D and Operations teams. Interacts with donors, funding agencies, and external partners, as well as consultants and service providers involved in fundraising activities. Collaborators, counterparts, and service providers are mainly in the functional area in and outside DNDi to get information, guidance, and feedback or to enlist cooperation. The incumbent has an external role focusing on exchanges on information and work with suppliers or officer level staff of partners and donors. Qualifications Minimum of 3 years’ experience with a graduate degree, at least one year with a post‑graduate degree. Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment and matrix structure. Experience of working in public and private sector is highly desirable. Graduate or post graduate degree. Ability to use initiative, prioritize, multi‑task, and work well under pressure to meet deadlines. Clear and systematic thinking that demonstrates good judgment and problem‑solving competencies. Very good communication skills in multicultural, multi‑lingual environments. Ability to work effectively as part of a multicultural team. Well organized and structured. Very good analytical skills. Ability to contribute to the project delivery under minimum supervision. Ability to manage small projects if delegated by upper levels with supervision. Ability to supervise an Intern or Apprentice. Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish. Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) is an asset. Interest in the responsible use of digital tools and artificial intelligence to support fundraising and administrative work. Good knowledge of Microsoft Suite. DNDi is committed to building a diverse, equitable and truly inclusive organisation. Our success and global reach are dependent upon our ability to encourage diversity and draw on the skills, understanding and experience of all our people. We particularly welcome applications from those who are underrepresented in DNDi and across the sector, especially women, and including, but not limited to, black and minority ethnic candidates, and those with other protected characteristics. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Production Control Engineer
description: The Production Control Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of production data, acting as the technical authority for hydrocarbon accounting, allocation, reconciliation, and reporting across offshore facilities. Support the classification and allocation of production deferment or losses according to internal guidelines. Review, maintain, and improve all hydrocarbon and fluids accounting processes, reporting routines, data acquisition, models, and methodologies, ensuring accurate distribution of production volumes and compliance with internal, industry, and regulatory requirements. Maintain the integrity and reliability of production accounting data, systems, and processes, ensuring full traceability and auditability of all reported figures. Participate in operational reviews and provide production accounting input to support operational decision making. Act as the technical focal point for production control and hydrocarbon accounting matters within the organization. Support regulatory audits, inspections, and data requests related to production and other fluids accounting. Prepare, validate, and submit mandatory monthly and annual production reports to the Brazilian regulatory authority (ANP). Support the implementation and maintenance of production accounting tools and data analytics platforms. Promote automation and digitalization initiatives related to production data management and reporting. Education Bachelor's Degree in any field of Engineering Experience Experience in this position in the Oil and Gas industry. Knowledge Familiar with metering regulation and best industry standards such as ANP, RTM, API, SOX Experience in hydrocarbon accounting and production data management Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, SQL Knowledge in Hydrocarbon Accounting Tools (such as Energy Components, EnergySys, PDM) #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Assessorar a gestão da Unidade na ausência deste, realizando interface com Gestor e demais equipes, acompanhando o processo de trabalho e direcionamento de fluxo, assim como mantendo a Gestão informada de toda e qualquer situação de não conformidade. Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada em rotinas administrativas em Unidade Hospitalar. Disponibilidade total para atuação em escala de cobertura. title: Manager, Stadium Entertainment
description: FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department: Events & Entertainment, Location: Brazil Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The Stadium Entertainment Manager will be responsible for the planning, coordination and delivery of all in‑stadium entertainment activations across all assigned venues of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment and supporting the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, this role ensures that all entertainment elements — including pre‑match programming, music, audio‑visual content, half‑time activations, and fan engagement moments — are delivered to the highest standard. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the Stadium Entertainment operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Stadium Entertainment Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with venue teams, technical suppliers, and the broader Entertainment department, the Stadium Entertainment Manager will act as the primary entertainment point of contact for their assigned venue(s), managing operational workflows, coordinating suppliers, and overseeing delivery timelines from a central coordination function. This role works in close collaboration with the on‑site venue entertainment teams, providing the planning structure, content, and operational direction required for seamless execution on match days. The Stadium Entertainment Manager is an office‑based coordination role suited to an experienced live events professional with strong project management skills, who can drive high‑quality entertainment delivery across multiple venues through effective planning, clear communication, and proactive stakeholder management. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Stadium Entertainment Delivery Manage the day‑to‑day planning and delivery of all entertainment activations at assigned venue(s). Execute the FIFA‑approved Entertainment Concept at venue level, maintaining quality and consistency throughout the tournament. Coordinate all entertainment elements on match days, including pre‑match shows, half‑time activations, music programming and AV content. Act as the primary on‑site entertainment point of contact for venue management, technical crews, and Functional Area partners. Team Support Support the Stadium Entertainment Team by contributing to day‑to‑day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards across all entertainment activities. Assist with the onboarding and support of Stadium Entertainment personnel—including full‑time staff, freelancers, and event‑time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness. Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing within the entertainment workstream. Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units involved in stadium entertainment delivery. Contribute to coordination between venue‑based entertainment teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution across all stadiums. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Ceremonies Team to ensure unified delivery across entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Technical & Production Coordination Liaise with technical suppliers including AV, LED, sound, and lighting providers to ensure correct installation and operation of all entertainment infrastructure. Support pre‑event technical surveys, production walkthroughs, and infrastructure assessments at assigned venues. Coordinate rehearsals and technical run‑throughs, ensuring all entertainment elements are tested and validated before match day. Manage show rundowns, cue sheets, and entertainment schedules for each match at assigned venue(s). Venue Readiness & Execution Support the preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), stadium production schedules, and PMC rundowns for Stadium Entertainment. Assist in production processes, including coordinating technical surveys, gathering stadium LED screen specs, AV infrastructure reviews, and supplier installation planning. Contribute to readiness activities and provide on‑site support during live operations to ensure delivery standards are met. Support problem solving during matchday entertainment, escalating issues to the Senior Manager as needed. Coordinate rehearsal planning, scheduling, documentation, and stakeholder communication in alignment with Senior Manager guidance. Support the validation of entertainment elements during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases. Assist with venue‑level pre‑production tasks, including gathering technical information, supporting infrastructure assessments, and coordinating installation planning. Content Production & Management Coordinate the receipt, testing, and deployment of all entertainment content at venue level, including music, video, graphics, and scripts. Ensure that all content is approved, correctly formatted, and delivered on time in line with operational deadlines. Maintain accurate records of content usage and ensure IP/copyright compliance at venue level. Planning, Scheduling & Documentation Prepare match‑day reports, schedules, show notes and post‑event summaries for the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager. Maintain up‑to‑date operational documentation including rundowns, contact lists, and venue entertainment plans. Participate in regular team meetings, briefings, and review sessions. Flag operational risks and elevate issues to the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager in a timely manner. Supplier & Budget Management Support procurement processes as directed by the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation. Manage day‑to‑day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s). Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost‑tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow‑up. Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalating risks to the Senior Manager as needed. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Coordinate with Venue Operations, Broadcast, Protocol, Safety, and other Functional Areas and stakeholders to integrate entertainment seamlessly into match‑day operations. Support early‑phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by line management aligned with project delivery. Support the Head of Entertainment and Senior Stadium Entertainment Manager in planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration. Support cross‑venue entertainment activities and cover other venues as required during the tournament. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events. Demonstrated experience delivering in‑venue or stadium entertainment programmes, including AV, music and audience engagement activations. Experience working within large‑scale multi‑venue events or major international sporting events is highly desirable. Track record of coordinating multiple suppliers and technical teams in high‑pressure, time‑critical environments. Experience working with broadcast operations and an understanding of live TV production constraints is an advantage. Skills & Competencies Administrative skills: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments. Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. Communication skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. Organizational skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. Problem‑solving skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. Cross‑functional collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. Interpersonal skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. Cultural sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. Passion for entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus. The right to work in Brazil. Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Pronto para dar a largada na sua carreira? Você domina a arte da massa perfeita, entende de tempo, temperatura e textura — e acredita que a excelência começa na base? No Grupo FIT , o(a) Pizzaiolo(a) é o(a) guardião(ã) de uma das nossas entregas mais queridas: a pizza. Com técnica apurada, disciplina e paixão pela gastronomia, garante padrão, sabor e estética em cada fornada. É quem transforma insumos em experiências, com atenção aos mínimos detalhes, respeito ao processo e ritmo constante na operação. Se você é comprometido(a), valoriza organização e entrega pratos que encantam pela simplicidade e precisão, essa é a sua pista para brilhar. Responsabilidades e atribuições Como Pizzaiolo no Grupo FIT , você será o maestro por trás de nossas pizzas, garantindo que cada uma seja uma obra-prima de sabor e apresentação. Suas principais responsabilidades e atribuições incluem: Massas, Produção e Padrão Técnico Preparar massas do zero, incluindo pesagem, batimento, descanso e controle de fermentação natural ou controlada. Controlar tempo, temperatura, umidade e manipulação da massa em todas as etapas do processo. Produzir discos com padrão de espessura, textura e leveza conforme os critérios definidos pela marca. Planejar produção diária com base no volume, evitando excesso ou falta de massa e insumos. Montagem, Forno e Finalização Cortar, organizar e manter abastecidos todos os ingredientes da linha de montagem. Montar as pizzas com precisão, respeitando gramaturas, harmonização de sabores e apresentação visual. Controlar ponto ideal de cocção e temperatura do forno (elétrico ou à lenha), garantindo crocância e uniformidade. Finalizar as pizzas com atenção aos detalhes, cuidando da estética, da embalagem (quando delivery) e da experiência visual. Higiene, Organização e Segurança Manter a área de produção limpa, organizada e funcional durante todo o turno. Cumprir normas da ANVISA e boas práticas de manipulação e armazenamento de alimentos. Zelar pela integridade dos equipamentos, limpeza dos utensílios e segurança da área de forno. Garantir que a pizza seja preparada e servida em condições ideais de higiene e apresentação. Insumos, Custos e Planejamento Controlar validade, giro e armazenamento dos ingredientes da pizza (massas, queijos, molhos, proteínas, etc.). Apoiar o controle do CMV da praça, otimizando o uso de insumos e evitando desperdícios. Sinalizar a necessidade de compras com antecedência e clareza, colaborando com a liderança da cozinha. Participar de inventários e controles de estoque da área, com foco em eficiência. Integração com a Equipe Trabalhar em sintonia com os demais profissionais da cozinha e o time de salão, garantindo fluxo harmônico da operação. Realizar passagem de turno com clareza, sinalizando pendências, status de produção e itens em falta. Participar de reuniões de cozinha, treinamentos técnicos e momentos de alinhamento com o líder de cozinha. Propor melhorias de processo, rendimento e sabor, sempre com foco em padronização e performance. Requisitos e qualificações Buscamos um profissional que se identifique com nosso propósito e tenha as seguintes qualificações: Organizacionais: disciplina que nos fortalece, segurança em cada atitude, gratidão que nos conecta, vibração que inspira. Habilidades Técnicas: dominar o trabalho com fermentação, montagem e cocção com disciplina e excelência, entender que uma boa pizza não é só sabor — é técnica, padrão, apresentação e agilidade. Habilidades Comportamentais: valorizar a limpeza, o cuidado com os insumos e o trabalho bem feito. Gostar de trabalhar em equipe e manter o bom humor mesmo nos momentos de pressão. Conhecimento: experiência com preparo de massas, abertura e finalização de pizzas. Domínio de forno, tempo e temperatura, com atenção à padronização, porcionamento e qualidade dos ingredientes. Vivência Desejável: comprovada como pizzaiolo ou auxiliar em pizzarias artesanais ou operações de alto volume. General Summary X‑Ray Tech Performs a full range of diagnostic radiographic examinations in the department, clinics, and operating room. Ensures radiation safety precautions are taken. Mammo Tech Demonstrates a thorough understanding of Imaging principles, theory, anatomy, and pathology processes while utilizing the most appropriate techniques and/or positioning for optimal examinations, as demonstrated by exam results. Communicates effectively with patients to obtain clinical history/informed consent from patients, or patients' charts, to assist the physician in optimizing the performance and interpretation of the examination, as evidenced by the exam results. Demonstrates the effective use of radiation protection procedures with collimation devices and protective shielding, as evidenced by incident reports. Maintains an orderly, safe, and clean environment. Ensures rooms are stocked with appropriate supplies for procedures. Performs and documents routine quality control testing of equipment. Performs/recognizes the need for routine maintenance of imagers/processors to maintain consistent quality images, as evidenced by the physician and exam results. Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração; Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações. Travel up to 30% to support on‑site engagements, workshops, and strategic meetings. Deep knowledge of IT networking; prior experience as a Network Architect is highly beneficial. Strong understanding of networking standards and protocols, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and segmentation principles. Experience with Operational Technology (OT) environments and industrial networks – a strong advantage. Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure network architecture. Network and Cybersecurity Certifications (CCNA, Security+) are a plus. Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) – required. Additional languages, such as Spanish, are a plus. Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and executive stakeholders. Customer‑centric mindset with the ability to build trusted, long‑term partnerships. Candidates should be comfortable with on‑site work 5 days a week in Rio de Janeiro. Willingness to travel up to 30%. About Claroty Claroty has redefined cyber‑physical systems (CPS) protection with an unrivaled industry‑centric platform built to secure mission‑critical infrastructure. The Claroty Platform provides the deepest asset visibility and the broadest, built‑for‑CPS solution set in the market comprising exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection – whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on‑premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Backed by award‑winning threat research and a breadth of technology alliances, the Claroty Platform enables organizations to effectively reduce CPS risk, with the fastest time‑to‑value and lower total cost of ownership. Our solutions are deployed by over 1,000 organizations at thousands of sites across all seven continents. Claroty is an equal‑opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment for all.
